credits.title: Ride to Meet the Opponent
credits.overview: A good-hearted food-delivery rider saves a tycoon and falls for his daughter, Ma Xiaoyun. When she’s trapped in a dangerous scheme, the rider rallies a film crew’s costumes, props and lights to stage a wild rescue and expose a 20-year secret.

credits.title: Lady Bug
credits.overview: In a small town in the north, Xu Maomao suddenly found herself in the pursuit of beauty. To find the true self, she tailored a special skirt with the help from her friend, Little Tailor. The parents and teachers are concerned about this, but Maomao tries to achieve understanding.

credits.title: Angels Wear White
credits.overview: In a small seaside town, two schoolgirls are assaulted by a middle-aged man in a motel. Mia, a teenager who was working on reception that night, is the only witness. credits.title: Battle With Heaven and Earth
credits.overview: The story follows the people of Yaozhihe Village as they battle harsh natural conditions to transform their impoverished mountain region.

credits.title: The Last Trial
credits.overview: Near retirement, grassroots judge Gu Chengshan discovers a flaw in a case he ruled. Refusing “mechanical justice,” he pushes for a retrial to correct the verdict and protect fairness.

credits.title: The Foliage
credits.overview: On her way back from a family visit, young female intellectual Xing-Yu meets the equally young and rebellious Si-Mong and the two fall in love. credits.title: Beijing Bicycle
credits.overview: A seventeen-year-old country boy working in Beijing as a courier has his bicycle stolen, and finds it with a schoolboy his age.

credits.title: Plain Shots
credits.overview: During the Anti-Japanese War, Eighth Route Army officer Ma Ying returns to his hometown to mobilize resistance against Japanese forces and traitors. As enemies plot to turn villagers against each other, Ma Ying must rally the people to prevent a devastating massacre.

credits.title: Call Me
credits.overview: Four parallel stories of people just getting by, unfolding over seven days in Beijing. For most of the story, the main characters mis-connect with others, except through their pagers.

credits.title: The Emperor's Shadow
credits.overview: Epic drama about China's first emperor (221 BC) who struggles to make his childhood best friend, now China's greatest composer, succumb to his will and compose a grand anthem to his exploits.
